answer: A seat is a pilotage licence: 200 supervised boardings, a number, and a quartz chronometer rated forty days. Each epoch the seed names a berth window and an entrance buoy; the pilot boards, and the master logs the conn time and the chronometer reading at the delta mouth. Two licences sharing a launch, a master or a serial fold to one vote, forfeiting 45,000 POA each. Launch hire is $600 a boarding and training three years; a thousand clones need a thousand rated chronometers and masters willing to swear to the log. A haven holds only while each hull inside it was counted at the entrance.
